name: Vercel Web Analytics

evidence.web: F02: primary category is hosted website traffic analytics; F15: visitors, pageviews, top pages, referrers, countries and devices

line: Adds website traffic and custom event reports to Vercel projects.

free.text: Hobby personal only: 50K events/month, 1-month reports; no custom events/UTM

pv.math: Assumes 1 pageview counts as 1 event, with no extra events. 10,000 uses 10,000 of the 50,000 free events a month.
Assumes 1 pageview counts as 1 event, with no extra events. 100K events cost $3, within the Pro plan's $20 shared monthly usage credit.
Assumes 1 pageview counts as 1 event, with no extra events. 1M events cost $30, leaving $10 after the Pro plan's $20 credit. Assumes no other billed usage.
